tldr: Mercury in the 6th house: thinking becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Mercury in the 6th house, this part of you works through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
